title: 第九章 上半场下半场第十章 通幽
slug: 盗三界第五百六十章黑影
lines: 许源突然将干尸一把拎起来，在心中默道：
虚空悄然浮现一行发光小字：
“毫无价值的东西不能被买卖。”
许源泄气地转过身，朝门口望去。
进门第一眼就看见自己手持一具画满血色咒语的干尸。
人类社会最不能容忍的，便是堕落入魔的邪修！
许源沉默着，脑子飞快转动。
不久之前的那一幕再次浮现于眼前。
“时间不多了……你要快一点掌握……这个……”
那个铜人的术毫无秘密可言。
它的手印和风流动穿过经脉明点的方式，无比清晰而完整的呈现在自己眼前。
一名刚进入炼气期的高中生，根本没有办法应对。
“谁来动手？这门上的阵法有些繁复，估计这家的主人研究过古代的阵法。”
“我来吧，我阵法之术还可以。”有人搭腔。
许源拎着干尸，神情渐渐平静下来。
警车堵在楼下，没有给自己任何逃离的机会。
content_en:
;;
They are breaking down the door!
what to do?
Xu Yuan suddenly picked up the mummy and said silently in his heart:
"Store, do you accept this stuff?"
A line of small luminous characters quietly appeared in the void:
“What is worthless cannot be bought or sold.”
Worthless!
Xu Yuan turned around in frustration and looked towards the door.
They're coming in!
The first thing he saw when he entered the door was that he was holding a mummy painted with bloody spells.
At first glance, he is an evil cultivator!
The most intolerable thing in human society is evil cultivators who have fallen into evil!
So you are dead?
Xu Yuan was silent, his mind spinning rapidly.
The scene not long ago came to mind again.
"Time is running out...you have to master it quickly...this..."
"...learn it...only then can you live..."
Sombra said.
——It does say so.
Xu Yuan fell into silence.
There is no secret to that bronze man's technique.
Its handprints and the way the wind flows through the bright points of the meridians appear in front of my eyes extremely clearly and completely.
—— deeply engraved in my memory.
The situation is already like this.
A high school student who has just entered the Qi refining period has no way to deal with it.
But——
If you use that technique——
What happens?
The voice outside the door sounded again:
"Who is going to do it? The formations on this door are a bit complicated. I guess the owner of this family has studied ancient formations."
"Let me do it, my formation skills are pretty good." Someone said.
"Count three, two, one, break the goal."
"Okay, sir."
Xu Yuan's expression gradually calmed down while carrying the mummy.
The timing is so clever.
I just came back.
The inspection begins immediately.
The police car was blocked downstairs, giving him no chance to escape.
